LanguageData.LP_Bs_HellsSpawn.description: [PAWN_nameDef] took shape from a torn-up contract, and the first thing seen was the iron gate of the Nine Hells.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_HellsSpawn.title: born of the Nine Hells
LanguageData.LP_Bs_HellsVeteran.description: [PAWN_nameDef] has fought demons in the tide of the Blood War for centuries, signing a new contract for each promotion.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_HellsVeteran.title: soldier of the infernal legion
LanguageData.LP_Bs_FeyChild.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was born in a forest of the Feywild where it is always dusk, and learned to sing before learning to walk.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_FeyChild.title: moon-born
LanguageData.LP_Bs_FeyCourtier.description: [PAWN_nameDef] runs errands, trades and hunts for the queen at court, and knows the price of every promise.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_FeyCourtier.title: the queen's courtier
LanguageData.LP_Bs_CelestialHost.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is an emissary of the good gods who stood in the light of the heavens for who knows how many years before first being sent to the mortal world.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_CelestialHost.title: emissary of the heavens
LanguageData.LP_Bs_CelestialBorn.title: formed in the light
